blurb: Alta Mesa Golf Club is an equity club owned & operated by their members and ranked one of the top 10 courses in Ranking Arizona Magazine 2025. We offer an 18-hole championship course designed by Architect, Dick Phelps. It incorporates six lakes on the gently rolling 160-acre course that extends to 7,127 yards. This exceptional design has a traditional feel with challenging fairways & tree-lined views approaching
